title: Prototype Guided Post-pretraining for Single-Cell Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.07938v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Single-cell representation learning (SCRL) from gene expression data offers a way to uncover the complex regulatory logic underlying cellular function. Inspired by large language models in natural language modeling, several single-cell pretrained models have recently been proposed that treat genes as tokens and cells as sentences. However, these models are fundamentally limited by the long-tailed nature of cell-type distributions and struggle to generalize under covariate shifts in gene expression data. While fine-tuning is often used to mitigate these issues, we observe that performance remains bounded. To address this challenge, we introduce CellRefine, a post-pretraining method that operates between the pretraining and fine-tuning stages of a single-cell foundation model. translated_title: 原型引导的单细胞表示学习预训练后方法
translated_abstract: 从基因表达数据中进行单细胞表示学习（SCRL）为揭示细胞功能背后复杂的调控逻辑提供了一种途径。受自然语言建模中大语言模型的启发，近来已有若干单细胞预训练模型被提出，这些模型将基因视为词元、将细胞视为句子。然而，这些模型从根本上受到细胞类型分布长尾特性的限制，并难以在基因表达数据发生协变量偏移时进行泛化。尽管微调常被用于缓解这些问题，但我们观察到其性能提升仍然有限。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了CellRefine，一种作用于单细胞基础模型预训练阶段与微调阶段之间的预训练后方法。CellRefine采用多方面的目标函数，将标记基因集作为结构先验来引导预训练后过程，并对潜在嵌入流形进行优化精炼。
tldr: 提出CellRefine，一种插入在单细胞基础模型预训练与微调之间的预训练后方法，通过将标记基因集作为结构先验的多目标优化来精炼潜在嵌入，从而缓解细胞类型长尾分布与协变量偏移导致的泛化受限问题。
en_tdlr: CellRefine is a post-pretraining method inserted between the pretraining and fine-tuning stages of single-cell foundation models, which uses a multi-faceted objective incorporating marker-gene sets as structural priors to refine latent embeddings and overcome the generalization limits caused by long-tailed cell-type distributions and covariate shifts.
